reviews.text: ongredients Skin Barrier Moisture Sun Cream is an exceptional choice if you struggle with dryness, sensitivity, or a stripped skin barrier and want an SPF that doubles as your morning moisturizer. It completely eliminates the trade-off between strong clinical UV protection and a comfortable, breathable skincare finish, making it a stellar daily asset for achieving a healthy, radiant complexion.
reviews.zh: ongredients Skin Barrier Moisture Sun Cream 係一款好好嘅選擇，如果你受乾燥、敏感或者皮膚屏障受損所困擾，又想搵一款兼當晨間保濕霜用嘅防曬。佢完全消除咗強效臨床級紫外線防護同舒適、透氣護膚效果之間嘅取捨，令佢成為日常用嚟達到健康、亮麗膚色嘅出色好幫手。

reviews.text: This sunscreen has a lightweight, moisturizing texture that blends easily without leaving a white cast. It feels comfortable on the skin, provides great daily sun protection, and gives a healthy, natural glow without feeling greasy. It layers well under makeup and doesn’t pill throughout the day. A great choice for anyone looking for a hydrating sunscreen that’s suitable for everyday use.
reviews.zh: 呢款防曬質地輕盈、補濕，推開好容易，唔會留低白色殘留。用落皮膚感覺舒服，日常防曬效果好好，亦會令皮膚有健康、自然嘅光澤，而且唔會油膩。疊喺化妝底下都好服貼，全日都唔會搓泥。對於想搵一款補濕、適合日常用嘅防曬嘅人嚟講，係一個好選擇。

reviews.text:
## 1. Ongredients Skin Barrier Lotion EX Jumbo

**Title:** **Perfect for Strengthening My Skin Barrier** ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I've been using this lotion every day, and it has made such a difference in keeping my skin hydrated and comfortable. The lightweight texture absorbs quickly without feeling greasy, yet provides long-lasting moisture. My skin feels softer, calmer, and less prone to dryness or irritation. The jumbo size is also great value and lasts a long time. It's an excellent daily moisturizer for anyone looking to support a healthy skin barrier.

## 2. Ongredients Moisture Sun Cream

**Title:** **Hydrating Sunscreen with No White Cast** ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

This sunscreen is everything I look for in a daily SPF. It has a lightweight, moisturizing texture that blends effortlessly into the skin without leaving a white cast or sticky finish. It keeps my skin hydrated throughout the day and sits beautifully under makeup without pilling. My skin feels protected, comfortable, and fresh, making this one of my favorite sunscreens for everyday wear.
reviews.zh:
## 1. Ongredients Skin Barrier Lotion EX Jumbo

**標題：** **好啱加強我嘅皮膚屏障** ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

我每日都用呢款乳液，佢對保持皮膚水潤同舒適真係好有幫助。質地輕盈，吸收快，唔會油膩，但可以長時間鎖住水分。皮膚摸落更柔軟、更平靜，亦冇咁容易乾燥或者刺激。Jumbo 裝都好抵，可以用好耐。對於想維護健康皮膚屏障嘅人嚟講，係一款好好嘅日常保濕產品。

## 2. Ongredients Moisture Sun Cream

**標題：** **補濕防曬，冇白粉感** ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

呢款防曬係我想要嘅日常防曬應有嘅所有條件。質地輕盈、補濕，好容易就推開喺皮膚上，唔會留低白色殘留或者黏膩感。全日都令皮膚保持水潤，疊喺化妝底下都好靚，唔會搓泥。皮膚感覺受到保護、舒適、清新，係我日常最鍾意嘅防曬之一。

reviews.text: I’ve been loving this sunscreen! It’s lightweight, non‑sticky, and gives my skin a healthy glow without leaving a white cast. The texture feels silky and absorbs quickly, making it perfect under makeup. I really appreciate how it keeps my skin hydrated throughout the day while protecting it from UV damage. It’s gentle enough for sensitive skin and doesn’t clog pores — definitely one of my favorite daily sunscreens!
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢款防曬！質地輕盈、唔黏，令皮膚有健康光澤，又冇白粉感。質感好絲滑，吸收快，喺化妝底下用都好啱。我好欣賞佢可以全日保持皮膚水潤，同時防止紫外線傷害。佢夠溫和，敏感皮膚都可以用，而且唔會堵塞毛孔，絕對係我最鍾意嘅日常防曬之一！

reviews.text: Este protector solar me gustó muchísimo. Cuando lo pones en la mano pareciera que va a ser muy espeso, pero en cuanto lo empiezas a esparcir en el rostro cambia por completo: se vuelve súper ligero, se distribuye muy bien y rápido. Además, rinde un montón porque con poco producto cubres toda la cara perfectamente. Yo tengo piel mixta y me ha funcionado increíble. A pesar de que deja un acabado con un brillo natural hermoso, cuando te tocas la cara se siente un efecto tipo velvet, súper suave como piel de durazno, y da la sensación de que no te hubieras colocado nada encima. ¡Es una excelente opción!
reviews.zh: 呢款防曬我好鍾意。擠喺手上嗰陣睇落好似會好厚身，但一開始喺面上推開，就完全唔同：超級輕盈，分佈得好好，又快。而且好出貨，少少份量已經可以覆蓋成張面。我係混合性皮膚，用落效果好神奇。雖然佢會留低一層自然嘅漂亮光澤，但摸落面時有種 velvet 效果，好滑，好似蜜桃皮咁，感覺好似咩都冇塗咁。係一個好好嘅選擇！

reviews.text: It has been such a comfortable everyday sunscreen for me. It feels more like a light moisturizer than a typical sunscreen, which makes it really easy to apply and reapply. The texture blends in smoothly without leaving any white cast or greasy finish, and my skin actually feels hydrated instead of dry after using it. I love how it sits under makeup because it doesn't pill or feel heavy throughout the day. On no-makeup days, it also gives a soft, healthy glow to my skin. Overall, it feels very skin-friendly and perfect for daily use, especially if you have a sensitive or dry barrier.
reviews.zh: 對我嚟講，呢款真係好舒服嘅日常防曬。佢感覺更似一款輕身嘅保濕霜，而唔係普通防曬，所以好易塗，亦好易補擦。質地推開好順滑，唔會留低白色粉感或者油膩感，用完皮膚實際上感覺水潤，而唔係乾燥。我好鍾意佢可以疊喺化妝底下，因為全日都唔會搓泥，亦唔會覺得厚重。唔化妝嗰日，佢亦都令皮膚有柔和、健康嘅光澤。整體嚟講，佢好啱皮膚，好適合日常用，特別係如果你皮膚比較敏感或者屏障乾燥。

reviews.text:
Formulado con Pantenol, Péptidos y Ácido Hialurónico que ayudan a hidratar y calmar la piel mientras fortalecen la barrera natural de la piel.
Presenta una textura suave que se adhiere perfectamente a la piel sin dejar sensación pegajosa. No deja el molesto with cast que suele tener la mayoria de las marcas, además de contenes vitamina C lo que ayuda a aclarar mientras proteje del daño solar, es una maravilla. Como dato adicional, no es recomendado usarlo alrededor de los jos, ya que provoca ligera irritación.
reviews.zh:
配方含有泛醇（Pantenol）、多肽同透明質酸，有助補濕同舒緩皮膚，同時加強皮膚天然屏障。
質地柔滑，貼合皮膚，唔會有黏膩感。唔會留低大部分品牌常見嘅令人討厭嘅白色殘留（white cast）；另外含有維他命 C，有助提亮膚色，同時防止紫外線傷害，真係好正。補充一點，唔建議喺眼睛周圍用，因為會引起輕微刺激。

reviews.text: The texture of this sunscreen is very eloquent but it bothers and stings my eyes. Super disappointing because I wanted to love this product.
reviews.zh: 呢款防曬嘅質地好精緻，但會令我眼睛唔舒服，甚至刺痛。非常失望，因為我本來好想好鍾意呢款產品。
